## Description

In dashboard_model.py, give NeedsYouItem the record type, full text, body, and the id of the work-item it belongs to (same slug or slug prefix, same effort; empty for effort-level questions). Add a derived finished flag on EffortView: true when the effort has phases or tasks and every phase and counted task is done. No goal-complete needs-you item (decision finished-effort-derived).

payload.title: Carry type, body and task on needs-you items and mark finished efforts
